title: Local constancy of a module subsheaf near a component generic point
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $\Lambda$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $\varphi:F\to G$ be a monomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Suppose $G$ is finite locally constant [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant]. For every generic point $\eta$ [def-sc-generic-point] of an irreducible component [def-weil-irreducible-components] of $X$, there exists an open neighbourhood $U$ of $\eta$ such that $F|_U$ is locally constant [def-constructible-locally-constant]. Finiteness of $F|_U$ and density of a union of such neighbourhoods are not conclusions of this lemma.

source.place: Tag 09BH, Proposition 59.74.1 (3), the generic-neighbourhood argument before Noetherian induction

proof.text: There are finitely many components. Remove those other than the component with generic point eta. Choose a pointed etale trivialization of G and remove the other components of its source. This reduces to an irreducible neighbourhood with G the constant sheaf of a finitely generated module M. Such a module is a geometric stalk of G, so it is finitely generated by finite local constancy. These operations retain a point above eta.

Exactness of stalks identifies the generic stalk of F with a submodule N of M. Noetherianity makes N finitely generated. Represent its generators on a common pointed etale neighbourhood. Equality of their images with fixed constant sections holds after refinement, since the stalk is a filtered colimit. The two pullbacks of each lift agree by monicity. Sheaf descent gives sections on the open image of this etale neighbourhood; their linear relations hold because they hold in M and F maps monically to constant M. Thus they define a monomorphism from constant N to F on that image.

The quotient by constant N embeds into constant M/N and has zero geometric generic stalk. If it had a nonzero geometric stalk, represent a nonzero germ on a pointed etale neighbourhood and refine until its image is a fixed nonzero constant section. The open image of this neighbourhood contains eta, so it has a point above a geometric generic point. There the germ of the same constant section is nonzero, contradicting the zero generic stalk of the quotient. Conservativity of geometric stalks makes the quotient zero. This is the argument of Stacks 09BG used in 09BH. Consequently F is constant N on the shrunk etale neighbourhood. Compose its trivializing cover with the surjective etale map to its open image to descend local constancy to an open neighbourhood of eta. A zero generic stalk uses N = 0; on an empty scheme the statement is vacuous.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_open_locallyConstant_of_mono_at_genericPoint
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    {F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)}
    (φ : F ⟶ G) [Mono φ] [IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf G]
    (η : X) (hη : η ∈ genericPoints X) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, η ∈ U ∧
      IsLocallyConstantSheaf ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).obj F)
